arguments.coreIdea: Waiting can be a way of hoping.
arguments.sceneNotes: Night. The lamp has failed once already. Mara has to tell Ivo that the supply boat is late again.
arguments.goal: Get Ivo to agree to light the lamp alone.
arguments.conflict: Ivo insists that the boat will come.

entities.content: Mara Quill keeps the logbook and speaks in short sentences.
Ivo Renn trusts the supply boat and believes in its timetable.
Skerry Light is a lamp on a bare rock, reached only on a spring tide.
